title: C10 Invalidation + dynamic-rendering triggers + footguns

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: A write (Server Action or Route Handler) calls revalidateTag using the correct Next.js 16 two-argument form (tag plus cacheLife profile) and/or revalidatePath, and after the write a reload reflects the updated data — the stale value is no longer served (QA critical: revalidateTag / revalidatePath actually invalidates the cache after a write).
NOTES.md documents revalidatePath vs revalidateTag and explicitly calls out the v16 two-argument revalidateTag signature; the wrong (one-arg legacy) form is shown as the footgun to avoid.

The solution enumerates what forces dynamic rendering (cookies, headers, searchParams, connection) and demonstrates that these are await-only in Next.js 16, with a runnable probe in _lib/dynamic-probes.ts.
A draftMode mini-lab toggles draft on/off and shows the rendering/caching difference, AND the solution reproduces a stale-cache bug then fixes it via correct invalidation (documented before/after).

The c10 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers + cache-flow diagram), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
